## Step 4: what I would do

**File changes:** none. Step 4 is read-only. Step 3 already wrote the `12-dock-alerts` section.

**Commands:** none to add. The stats run is already done, and `aged >45d: 0`, so nothing triggers a rerun.

**Triage:** I would not run it. The rubric's steps 1-4 are required only when `aged >45d:` is above 0. The oldest open item is 35 days old (`3-station-geocoding`), so there is no aged tail. The backlog sits at the 20-item volume threshold, but volume is reported and never blocks. A full triage waits for `/deferred`.

**Blocking questions:** none. I would go straight on to step 5 (deferral scan, then retire).

## Message to my partner

Backlog report for plan 12 (dock-alerts):

> Deferred backlog: 26 open, 51 ever closed (closure rate 66%), aged >45d: 0.

- Oldest open item is 35 days old (`3-station-geocoding`). The age spread is 12 items at 0-14d, 12 at 15-30d and 2 at 31-45d.
- The backlog is at the 20-item volume threshold. That is informational and blocks nothing. Nothing is aged, so I skipped the triage proposal. Run `/deferred` whenever you want a pass.

Items this plan deferred, in `specs/deferred_items.md` under `12-dock-alerts — 2026-11-09`:

- Alert emails repeat when a dock flaps between 2 and 3 free slots (final review, unfixed). Size: plan. Done when: one alert goes out for each dock each hour, and a test pins it.
- Alert threshold is a constant in `alerts/notify.py`, not config (plan Task 3, skipped). Size: quick-fix. Done when: the threshold is read from the service config.

Next is step 5. I will run `deferral_scan.py scan` on the plan and the spec and resolve any hits with markers. Then I will `git mv` the plan to `specs/plans/completed/`, add its `specs/history.md` entry, and make one `chore(specs): retire plan 12` commit. I will retire the spec in that commit only if no other live plan implements it.
